theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Industrials (+1.06%) and Energy (+0.91%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.03%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.02%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.25%, defensives -0.33%, and value/cyclicals +0.29% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.02%, Dow -0.21%, Nasdaq -0.08% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.14%. The VIX fell 1.55% to 15.21, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.62% to $4,671.90, crude oil was little changed at $81.57, and bitcoin slipped 0.11% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
